choice.recruit: Would you like to join us?
response.recruit.admire.1: All right. I can see the sense in following someone who has earned my trust.
response.recruit.admire.2: I was hoping you would ask. Give me a place in your group and I will pull my weight.
response.recruit.admire.3: Yes. I respect what you are building, and I would rather help than stand outside it.
response.recruit.fear.1: I do not like being cornered, but I know when I am outmatched. I will come with you.
response.recruit.fear.2: Fine. I will follow for now. Keep your word and we will not have a problem.
response.recruit.fear.3: You have made your point. I will join, but do not mistake caution for friendship yet.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.1: I am not ready to put my life in your hands. We need more time before you ask that again.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.2: You seem capable, but I do not know you well enough to join your group.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.3: That is a serious promise. We have not built enough trust for me to make it.
response.recruit.reject.leader.1: I already have people depending on me. I cannot walk away from them for your group.
response.recruit.reject.leader.2: I am responsible for this shelter. Until that changes, I am staying here.
response.recruit.reject.cooldown.1: We already had this conversation today. Give me time to think before you press me again.
response.recruit.reject.cooldown.2: Not again today. Let us see how things stand tomorrow.
response.recruit.reject.general.1: I cannot make that decision right now. There is too much working against it.
response.recruit.reject.general.2: No. I appreciate the offer, but joining you is not possible at the moment.
response.recruit.reject.general.3: I need to sort out a few things before I can even consider leaving with you.
locked.familiarity: You do not know each other well enough yet.
locked.approval: This relationship is not close enough yet.
